newsitem.title: USA: Magal Security Systems sells 2 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Magal Security Systems sells 2 mln shrs.

text.p: Magal Security Systems Ltd said Friday it has sold two million shares of stock at $5.50 per share.

The proceeds, said Magal, will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions, investments in complementary businesses, products or technologies, and research and development.
Magal makes computerized security systems that automatically locate and identify intruders, and systems which can identify explosive devices hiddeen in luggage, packages or other parcels.
The company said its products are used to protect national borders and sensitive facilites from terrorism and other threats.
